## Highlights

- Create safe draft tasks and understand when each task is runnable.
- Start tasks through local trigger keys, bulk Trigger Sets, or stable filesystem events.
- Diagnose failed runs with clearer process output and effective group eligibility.
- Adjust Schedule and Activity columns with layouts that persist across sessions.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#110---2026-09-05) for every change.
